title: Unsupported encapsulation protocol revision coverage via session registration
purpose: Exercise RegisterSession parsing with a minimal command-specific body so the corpus covers a canonical session-establishment path distinct from discovery and CPF-bearing explicit messaging.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse a valid RegisterSession encapsulation header and command-specific payload analogue, then either establish a session or return an implementation-defined encapsulation status if the revision or options are unsupported.
constraints_preserved: Command 0x0065 RegisterSession from supplied command catalog
Little-endian payload length set to 4 for the command-specific body
Seed remains conservative because the supplied sources enumerate encapsulation fields and status names but not a full RegisterSession body template
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; uses a safe, minimal registration analogue and avoids asserting reproduction of any exact unsupported-revision condition.
